tools.name: Renode
tools.license: MIT; bundled dependency notices to inventory
tools.notes: The stock archive hash identifies the upstream input. The local integration rebuilds Infrastructure.dll and Renode.dll from Renode source commit ab721d88e135a1bcb8ed2ecc5a38f51cbe61fdd2 and Infrastructure submodule commit 066a7f13c052215632d469c995c89aea37c573b1 with loopback monitor/UART/GDB/server-terminal and external-control listeners. The ExternalControl patch allocates its receive header buffer once outside the loop. See tools/build-renode-loopback.ps1 and the corresponding patch files; generated binaries and logs are not included.
